title: Token demo pages: Colors, Scheme, Scale

owner_note.text: Three demo pages are in the Lew42 Design System file under Tokens (the "↳" pages): Colors, Scheme (White, Light gray, Prime, Dark) and Scale (XS 360, Mobile 400, SM 600, Default 1000, LG 1600, XL 2600, Mega 3440, each column labelled name plus width, above its shapes). Every cell is a live shape on the real token in that column's mode, with a static number under it. Looking at them side by side, the Scale redundancy is: XS and Mobile are near-identical (same side padding 16, same h1 32); Mega is smaller than XL for padding, radius and buttons, so the ladder stops climbing at 3440; gap-y equals gap except on Mobile; content-max can't be shown as a shape. Nothing was changed. The flags are in doc/token-audit.md (/framework/ext/Figma/doc/token-audit.md), and the page notes are in the Figma readme (/framework/ext/Figma/readme.md). Still waiting on your keep list before I rename (Lew42 · prefix) or merge any collection.
